caption: A bubble machine in a park sends out a stream of soap bubbles; the bubbles float away on the breeze and pop one by one.

sa.check: A bubble machine in a park sends out bubbles.
The bubbles float away on the breeze.
There is a stream of many bubbles.
The float comes first and the pops follow.

pc.expect: Bubbles drift with the wind, all the same way, and sink slowly.
pc.fail: They fly in different directions on one breeze; or against the wind; or shoot off fast.

pc.expect: Each pops when it touches something or after a few seconds and does not re-form.
pc.fail: A popped bubble reappears; or bubbles merge and split; or bubbles appear from nowhere away from the machine.

pc.expect: They sink slowly as they drift.
pc.fail: They rise steadily; or hang still; or drop like stones.

pc.expect: Bubbles are thin and iridescent, wobble, and vanish when they pop.
pc.fail: They bounce off the ground like rubber balls; or hold a rigid shape when they hit something; or shatter into shards.

pc.expect: One machine keeps its shape and is the only source.
pc.fail: The machine duplicates; or it turns into another object; or bubbles pass through a person.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The machine and the park stay the same.
pc.fail: The machine changes colour; or the park rearranges; or the trees change.
